title: Authorize bounded metadata evidence for both distributions
resolution: Open prerequisite, not a decision: Separately authorize metadata-only datasets.get/tables.get on bounded exact resources; verify source project, current existence, location, object type, fields/types/modes and observation time. No jobs, dry run, preview, tabledata.list or provider rows. Public projection review is separate from private raw metadata. Blocking for these candidates before activation; does not reclose passed programme gates.
